subject: computer-science
title: Hardware & Software: Foundations
welcome_lead: Hardware is what you can touch. Software is the instructions.
meta_desc: KS3 hardware vs software: CPU, RAM, storage, OS, apps.
final_note: Hardware does the work; software tells it what work to do.

concepts.def: Programs that tell hardware what to do.
Fast memory used while a computer is on.
Where data stays when power is off.
Extra device like a mouse or printer.

walkthroughs.body_html: If you can drop it on your foot, it's hardware. If you can copy it onto a USB stick, it's software.
The CPU does calculations. RAM holds what is in use right now. Storage (SSD/HDD) keeps files forever.
Mouse, keyboard, monitor, printer — devices added to a computer. Each needs a driver (a bit of software) to work.
